headline: Blocked, leaking
or no heat? Call OC.
copy.sub: Blocked drains, emergency leaks, boilers and showers across Welwyn and Hertfordshire. Open 24 hours, quick to respond and fair on price.
copy.about_alt: A finished walk-in shower with a sliding glass door, fitted by OC Plumbing & Gas
copy.lede: Brett runs OC Plumbing & Gas, a local plumbing and heating engineer covering Welwyn and Hertfordshire. Customers have had him out for an emergency leak, a blocked drain, a new shower and a brand-new boiler, and they all say the same thing: quick to respond, tidy and fair on price.
copy.services_intro: Drains, leaks, boilers and bathrooms. Big jobs and emergencies.

services.title: Blocked drains and blockages
services.blurb: Blocked sinks, toilets, showers and internal drains cleared, and the cause found so it doesn't come back.
services.intro: Water not going down? Brett clears the blockage and checks the pipework behind it.

services.title: Emergency leaks
services.blurb: Burst pipes, leaks and drips sorted fast, day or night.
services.intro: Open 24 hours, so a leak gets stopped before it ruins a ceiling.

services.title: New boilers
services.blurb: Old boilers removed and new ones fitted, with everything explained when it's done.
services.intro: Fitted to a high standard, the site left tidy, and you shown how it all works.

services.title: Boiler and heating repairs
services.blurb: No heating, no hot water, pressure loss and radiators that won't warm up.
services.intro: The fault found and fixed, and you told what went wrong.

services.title: Showers and bathrooms
services.blurb: New showers, toilets, basins and taps fitted with real attention to detail.
services.intro: From a new shower to a whole bathroom, plumbed in neatly.

services.title: Gas work
services.blurb: Gas hobs and cookers connected or capped off, and gas pipework run or moved.
services.intro: Gas jobs done safely and properly.

reviews: Had this plumber round a couple of times for a couple of different jobs now and his work and customer service has been nothing less then exceptional!!
I’ve used OC Plumbing for a few jobs around my house (Welwyn area) and now wouldnt go anywhere else for plumbing. Amazing response for emergency leak.
Very good workmanship and fair prices will 100% use again in future.

They fitted me a brand-new boiler and the whole process was smooth and professional from start to finish. They were punctual, friendly, tidy, and clearly knew what they were doing. The installation was completed to a very high standard, and they took the time to explain everything to me once the job was finished.
Rapid response and very reasonable rates
